title: [2.8.2.13-Dev] Last Bolus does not match treatment and pod history.
body:
**Fact:**
* A bolus (0.2U) given at 19:16 and was recorded correctly in pod history, graph and treatments page.
* Pod was deactivated at 19:26
* New Pod initialized at 19:34

**Issue:**
In pod status, in Last Bolus it was falsely recorded as "9 mins ago" (21:01) while it was actually given 2h ago. No SMBs triggered.

**Assumption:**
Last Bolus entry keeps history from old pod until a new bolus is given by the new pod. Possible replication on giving a bolus before a pod change and checking the last bolus entry which will possibility freeze between the bolus time and pod deactivation time.
